basic_details.job_title: DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 14 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Fourteen Guest Special Needs Educator posts are open in PM SHRI high schools of Jangaon district, on a purely temporary basis for five months (November 2026 to March 2027) at an honorarium of Rs.16,500/- a month. The test is on 22 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

content_sections.heading: About DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educators
content_sections.text: The District Educational Officer's Office of Jangaon District, Telangana, is filling these posts to support Children with Special Needs (CwSN) in PM SHRI high schools of the district. The recruitment follows the instructions and guidelines issued by the State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana. The notice dated 16 November 2026 is signed by Sandeep Kumar Jha, I.A.S., District Educational Officer, Jangaon District.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their application in the prescribed application format, with self-attested copies of the certificates listed under Enclosures, at this place: District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District The last date for submission is 20 November 2026. Applications received after the deadline and incomplete applications will not be considered. A handwritten note beside the place of submission refers to office hours. The notice does not attach the application format and does not say where it can be obtained; for more details, the notice asks candidates to contact the District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District during office working hours.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 14 vacancies are for one post, Guest Special Needs Educator, in the category "PM SHRI schools" (total 14). Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications: Degree with B.Ed. (Special Education), or B.Ed. (General) with a one-year Diploma in Special Education, or B.Ed. (General) with a two-year Diploma in Special Education, or B.Ed. (General) with Post Graduate Professional Diploma in Special Education (PGPD), or B.Ed. Special Education and Post Graduate Professional Certificate in Special Education (PGPC), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Mental Retardation), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Multiple Disability: Physical & Neurological), or PG Diploma in Special Education (Loco motor Impairment and Cerebral Palsy), or Secondary Level Teacher Training Course in Visual Impairment, or Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf, or B.A. B.Ed. in Visual Impairment. Candidates must possess all the prescribed eligibility conditions and qualifications. The application must include the RCI registration certificate as applicable under the rules. Experience is not a stated requirement, but candidates with experience in the relevant field may be given additional preference. Eligible local candidates get the opportunity first, in the priority order given under Selection Process. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Monthly honorarium: Rs.16,500/- (Rupees sixteen thousand five hundred only). Period of appointment: five months (November 2026 to March 2027). The appointment is purely temporary and short-term. The appointment ends automatically as soon as the fixed period is over. The appointment gives no right or claim to a government job or to regularisation in future. For the full wording of each qualification, candidates can check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educators Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Guest Special Needs Educators will have to carry out these duties and responsibilities: Identify Children with Special Needs (CwSN) and assess their needs. Provide special educational support and the necessary teaching interventions. Help in the school enrolment, retention and educational progress of children with special needs. Coordinate with IERPs, Mandal Educational Officers and Headmasters. Bring the services of the Bhavitha Centres within reach of the children. Conduct school visits, home visits and follow-up monitoring programmes, and maintain the prescribed records. Perform other duties related to Samagra Shiksha assigned by the officers concerned.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following must be attached to the application: Certificates of educational qualifications. Professional qualification certificates in Special Education. RCI registration certificate, as applicable under the rules. Relevant experience certificates (if any). Local residence certificate / certificate proving the relevant local status. Aadhaar card or other prescribed identity proof. Recent passport size photo.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice fixes a test for the candidates and gives the order in which eligible local candidates get the opportunity. The test will be held on 22 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at the IDOC Complex, Ground Floor, Main Conference Hall, Jangaon. The notice does not describe the subjects, marks or duration of the test. Eligible local candidates will be given the opportunity based on merit, the vacancies available and suitable qualification, in this order of priority: Candidates belonging to the concerned village. Candidates belonging to the concerned mandal. Candidates belonging to Jangaon district. Among eligible candidates, those with experience in the relevant field may be given additional preference. The District Educational Officer, Jangaon has the right to verify the candidates' certificates and qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must work in the allotted PM SHRI schools and, as needed, also serve in the allotted Bhavitha Centres. Keeping the needs of children with special needs in view, the services of selected Guest Special Needs Educators may be used within the allotted PM SHRI schools, clusters or mandals. The recruitment process follows the instructions and guidelines issued by the State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha, Telangana. The decision of the competent authority on the recruitment process is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Special Needs Educator vacancies are there in DEO Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 Guest Special Needs Educator vacancies in PM SHRI high schools of Jangaon district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 20 November 2026; applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Guest Special Needs Educator post in Jangaon?
faq.answer: Candidates need any one of 11 listed qualifications, such as a Degree with B.Ed. (Special Education), B.Ed. (General) with a Diploma in Special Education or PGPD, a PG Diploma in Special Education, Senior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf or B.A. B.Ed. in Visual Impairment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs.16,500/- (Rupees sixteen thousand five hundred only).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator posts?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the prescribed format, with self-attested copies of the listed certificates, at the District Educational Officer's Office, Jangaon District by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the test for the Guest Special Needs Educator posts?
faq.answer: The test is on 22 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at the IDOC Complex, Ground Floor, Main Conference Hall, Jangaon.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets priority in the DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator selection?
faq.answer: Eligible local candidates get priority on merit, vacancies and qualification: first those of the concerned village, then the concerned mandal, then Jangaon district; candidates with relevant experience may get additional preference.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Guest Special Needs Educator job in Jangaon permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary for five months, from November 2026 to March 2027, ends automatically after that period, and gives no right to a government job or regularisation.

faq.question: Q9. Is RCI registration required for the DEO Jangaon Guest Special Needs Educator application?
faq.answer: The RCI registration certificate, as applicable under the rules, is one of the documents to be enclosed with the application.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected Guest Special Needs Educators work?
faq.answer: They will work in the allotted PM SHRI schools and, as needed, in the allotted Bhavitha Centres, and their services may be used within the allotted schools, clusters or mandals.
